defaultChatParams.title: Default Chat Parameters
defaultChatParams.description: System-wide defaults for system prompt and model parameters. Conversations without a per-thread override fall back to these.
defaultChatParams.systemPromptHint: Default instructions prepended to every conversation. Appended before the built-in charting/math guidance.
defaultChatParams.temperatureHint: Higher values make output more random, lower values more focused. Range 0–2.
defaultChatParams.maxTokensHint: Maximum number of tokens to generate in the response. Leave empty for the model default.
defaultChatParams.topPHint: Nucleus sampling: consider tokens comprising this probability mass. Range 0–1.
defaultChatParams.frequencyPenaltyHint: Penalize tokens that have appeared frequently. Range -2 to 2.
defaultChatParams.presencePenaltyHint: Penalize tokens that have appeared at least once. Range -2 to 2.
defaultChatParams.topKHint: Only consider the top K tokens at each step. Leave empty for the model default.
defaultChatParams.stopSequencesHint: Comma-separated strings that stop generation. Maximum 4.
